Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Associate position with the GSCC Built Environment Hub in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your mission of shifting narratives toward practical living standards and building decarbonization.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write targeted content, and build WordPress sites, honing the skills needed to translate complex topics into compelling stories. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to implement structured data and optimize for AI-powered search, aligning with your need for innovative communication strategies.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am willing to relocate to Brussels. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. My experience with cross-border coordination and tools like Slack and Google Workspace makes me well-suited for this role.

I am excited about the opportunity to support EU-wide campaigns and amplify diverse voices in the built environment sector. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Associate position with the GSCC Built Environment Hub. As a digital marketer with a strong foundation in SEO, content creation, and web development, I am drawn to the opportunity to translate complex EU building regulations into narratives that resonate with everyday people—turning abstract climate policy into tangible improvements in comfort, health, and energy bills.

In my current role at Episto, I have honed the ability to craft clear, engaging content that drives organic visibility. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog posts, and build WordPress sites, all while tracking performance with analytics tools. This experience has taught me to distill technical information into accessible stories, a skill directly applicable to communicating about the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive and ETS2.

My independent project, mirook.com, showcases my initiative and technical acumen. I designed and built a multi-page site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and optimized for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and deliver measurable results—qualities essential for operational coordination and campaign support.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am prepared to relocate to Brussels. My fluency in English and Turkish, along with a B1 level in Dutch, positions me to collaborate effectively across European country desks. I am comfortable using Slack and Google Workspace, and I thrive in remote-first, multicultural environments.

I am particularly inspired by GSCC's commitment to inclusive climate communication. I am eager to contribute to mapping partner ecosystems, supporting media relations, and elevating diverse voices. I am confident that my organizational skills, attention to detail, and passion for climate action will make me a valuable asset to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to the Built Environment Hub's impactful work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · Content · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp; willing to relocate to Brussels. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.
